title: Offer
description: Schema for offer information in the RAG data system

id.description: Unique identifier for the offer (UUID format)

brand_id.description: Foreign key reference to the brand associated with this offer

redeem_url.description: URL to redeem or activate the deal

sample_q.description: Gives LLM trainers ready-made prompt/response pairs to use in training
examples: Discount codes from Walgreens in the US

country_code.description: ISO country code where the offer is valid
